Name: Marco baseline
Description: Opinionated Windows hardening baseline evaluated from data the collectors already gather. Null inputs read Unknown, never Fail. Copy this file into Marco.Data\compliance\ and edit to make your own pack; same-id rules replace these.

Rules.Name: BitLocker on OS volume
Rules.Description: The operating system volume is BitLocker-protected.

Rules.Name: SMB1 disabled
Rules.Description: The SMBv1 server is not enabled.

Rules.Name: No failing disks
Rules.Description: No disk reports SMART failure prediction or an unhealthy status.

Rules.Name: Antivirus enabled
Rules.Description: Defender or a third-party antivirus product is enabled.

Rules.Name: Antivirus signatures current
Rules.Description: Signatures are no older than the threshold.

Rules.Name: Firewall on all profiles
Rules.Description: Domain, private and public firewall profiles are all on.

Rules.Name: RDP requires NLA
Rules.Description: Remote Desktop, when enabled, requires Network Level Authentication.

Rules.Name: Secure Boot enabled
Rules.Description: UEFI Secure Boot is on.

Rules.Name: TPM 2.0 present and enabled
Rules.Description: A TPM 2.0 is present and enabled.

Rules.Name: Patched recently
Rules.Description: At least one hotfix installed within the threshold.

Rules.Name: No passwordless enabled accounts
Rules.Description: No enabled local account allows an empty password.

Rules.Name: No automatic logon
Rules.Description: Winlogon AutoAdminLogon is off (a stored password would log the machine in by itself).

Rules.Name: OS still supported
Rules.Description: The operating system release has not passed its end-of-support date (bundled EOL table).

Rules.Name: LAPS manages the local admin password
Rules.Description: Windows LAPS or legacy LAPS manages this host.

Rules.Name: UAC enabled
Rules.Description: User Account Control is on.

Rules.Name: SMB signing required
Rules.Description: The SMB server requires signing.

Rules.Name: Automatic updates not disabled
Rules.Description: Windows Update is not disabled by policy.

Rules.Name: Remote token filtering intact
Rules.Description: LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy is not set (local accounts keep filtered tokens over the network). Note: Marco's own remote inventory with local accounts needs this OFF — disable this rule if that trade-off is accepted.

Rules.Name: No pending reboot
Rules.Description: No servicing operation is waiting for a restart.

Rules.Name: Defender real-time protection
Rules.Description: When Defender is the active antivirus, real-time protection is on.

Rules.Name: Defender tamper protection
Rules.Description: When Defender is the active antivirus, tamper protection is on.

Rules.Name: Local Administrators limited
Rules.Description: The local Administrators group has no more members than the threshold.

Rules.Name: Defender scanned recently
Rules.Description: A Defender quick scan ran within the threshold.
